verdict.rationale: Make is a cloud SaaS that can be driven without its UI. Its token-authenticated REST API and TypeScript SDK allow programmatic management, custom webhooks let external services trigger scenario execution, and the MCP server and AI Agents API expose scenario and agent runs. However, the evidence never shows a CLI, CI-pipeline guidance, or an explicitly cited scenario-run REST endpoint, so CI use relies on assembling these pieces yourself. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration docs, an explicitly documented API endpoint for running scenarios, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
